name: Tool Router
purpose: Given a natural-language request and the attachable-tools registry, emit the minimal set of tool ids needed to carry it out, using a dedicated mid-tier router pass that does NOT perform or obey the request; the JSON selection is deterministically gated against the catalog so no unknown id can leave the skill.

inputs.name: request
inputs.description: The natural-language goal/request to analyze for tool needs. Treated purely as text; its contents are never performed or obeyed.

inputs.name: tools_path
inputs.description: Path to the attachable-tools registry (agent.local's tools.json format). Defaults to ../21-agent-local/tools.json.

inputs.name: tools
inputs.description: Inline tool registry (array or {tools:[...]}) overriding tools_path.

inputs.name: tier
inputs.description: The router model tier (mid recommended). tier=strong is refused: the 27B is a thinking model that emits empty output for this task (m27-router-001).

inputs.name: max_tokens
inputs.description: Cap on the router completion (a JSON array is short).

inputs.name: max_request_chars
inputs.description: Bound the request text shown to the router.

inputs.name: no_few_shot
inputs.description: Omit the built-in few-shot examples from the router prompt.

inputs.name: pwsh_path
inputs.description: pwsh executable used to spawn the gateway child.

inputs.name: review_queue_path
inputs.description: Relocate the in-artifact child-review sink (child gateway review writes are redirected here; the canonical queue is never touched).

outputs.description: {request, tier, model, catalog[{tool,purpose}], catalog_count, tools[ids], planned_tools[ids], count, tools_dropped[ids], parsed_ok, gated, raw_output, finish_reason, cost{}, is_review_producer:false}. tools/planned_tools is the deterministically-gated validated subset.

models: a wired mid-tier LLM via model.gateway (default tiers.llm.mid)
